description: 🏠✨ Modern and luxurious apartment for 6 people, in the heart of Saint-Germain-des-Prés, a historic, cultural and artistic area! It offers a cozy living room with sofa bed, air conditioning and heating, a bedroom with bunk bed, a bedroom with queen size bed, open kitchen with dining room, two shower rooms (one with toilet) and a separate toilet. Join Notre-Dame de Paris and the Louvre Museum within a 14-minute walk.The space🏠 Apartment on the first floor without elevator access🛋️ Living room with a sofa bed 📺 TV and Wi-Fi🍳 Kitchen equipped with stove, oven, dishwasher and coffee maker, kettle, microwave🍽️ A dining room🛏️ One bedroom with bunk bed🛏️ A bedroom with a queen size bed🚿 Two shower rooms, one with toilet 🚽 A toilet✨🏠 The 6th arrondissement of Paris is a must-see destination during your visit to the City of Light. Located on the left bank of the Seine, it is famous for its bohemian atmosphere and iconic sites such as the Jardin du Luxembourg and the Saint-Sulpice church. Stroll through famous literary cafés such as Café de Flore and Les Deux Magots, or explore the charming shops and art galleries of Rue de Buci. Discover the cultural treasures of the Eugène Delacroix Museum and the House of Auguste Comte. The 6th arrondissement is a real invitation to discover and stroll.🍽️ RESTAURANTS La Jacobine (French)Huguette, Bistro de la mer (Seafood Bistro)Côté Saint-GermainLe Paris ParisSatheesBurger & FriesChez Bartolo RestaurantLa SociétéLe Comptoir des Saints-PèresCook'n Saj (Mediterranean)Otiamo (Italian)NarroPépita☕️ BARS & CAFÉS O'jasonL'antidote Ancamédie de la BièreCave La BourgagneAux doux RaisinsLe Piona Vache (Jazz Club)🏛️ PLACES TO SEE Mosque of Paris Arènes de LutècePlace de MongeThe Jardin des Plantes Wallace Fountain MuralNational Museum of Natural Histor
